title: Page 8
content_zh:
现在吃东西只是为了维系自己的生命，让自己能活下去，也让自己……能再为廷汉多做一些事。
吃完饭，沈明慧帮忙将碗盘都收到厨房，帮忙清洗。住在这里，能帮的忙，她都应该尽量帮。
毕竟她在这里白吃白喝，不做点事情，一来，她良心不安；二来，她必须让自己多做一点事情，这样才不会再胡思乱想，才不会继续哀伤下去。
她知道现在的她对于未来很茫然，甚至很绝望——她一度不知道该怎么一个人走下去，又能走到哪里？
他死了……
她一个人只能面对着噬人的空虚，只能独自面对着日夜无情的更迭循环，再也不知道自己还能做什么？
“明慧，走吧！”
沈明慧在水糟前发呆，她将碗盘都洗干净了。没事做的好只能这样胡思乱想，任由脑袋往死胡同里走。
这就是为什么她为了让自己很忙，从早上醒过来到晚上睡觉，她必须安排自己马不停蹄的做好多好多的事。
她跟着拿起锄头，陪着一名比丘尼来到粗舍后面的小菜圃，今天她要帮忙整地，准备种下菜苗，期待新的蔬菜能够长成。
这只是她在这里两个多月的生活中，其中要做的一件事，除此之外，她还会帮忙整理精舍，扫地拖地、整理书房，直到晚上，她才有时间做自己的事。
可是她很怕晚上，她怕天黑了以后，即便是到了深夜，她还是会为自己安排做一大堆事情，只求不要下来、不要静下来……
“明慧，今天就是种新的蔬菜了。”
“那我们要怎么做呢？”她当然不会，出生在沈家，吃好喝好，若非来到这里，她根本不知道菜是种出来的。
现在的她，穿着简单，牛仔裤加T恤，再也不是那个在舞台上演奏幽雅乐音的沈明慧。
“把土翻一翻，让土壤的养分可以均匀分布，然后再种下菜苗，这样就可以等待收成了。”
沈明慧点点头，她脱下鞋子，走进菜圃，土壤冰冰的，踩起来软软的，感觉还满好玩的。
她露出难得的笑容，看着不算大的菜圃，这时，她突然看见远方角落里有好几棵日前收成时没有拔起来的菜。
问这里的人，那是因为那些菜都长不好，菜叶枯黄，或者说没长成，整个菜瘦瘦小小的，一看就知道不能吃。
可是沈明慧不懂，既然如此，为什么不拔起来，然后丢掉呢？既然那些菜都不能吃，干嘛让它留在菜圃里？

沈明慧不懂，但是她想，既然现在要种新的蔬菜，要先整地，那么那些蔬菜应该也不能继续留在原地了。
所以沈明慧走上前去，打算将那数量不算多，约十几株长得不完全的蔬菜统统拔起来放在一旁，打算等一下拿去丢掉。
她努力的拔着，其实拔得很辛苦，因为蔬菜的根深藏在地底，有时候不太好拔。
难怪要收成时，一定要拿镰刀来，用割的把蔬菜都割起来。
沈明慧笑了笑，难怪那句名言会说，“凡含泪播种，必欢呼收割”，收成蔬菜的时候，真的是用割的啊！用拔的还拔不起来呢！
她用力的拔，拔了好几棵，但是每一棵都很费力，搞得她自己满头大汗，喘息连连。
老天！真麻烦，早知道那天就建议师父把这些菜都割起来丢掉，现在也不用费这么大力气了……
边抱怨，沈明慧边继续拔菜，但就在此时，后头有人失笑，连连惊呼。
“明慧，那些菜不用拔！”
一回头，“为什么？不是要整地吗？”
这个比丘尼也走进菜圃里，脸上带着和蔼的笑容，走到沈明慧身边。现场好几棵蔬菜都已经拔了起来，放在一旁，地上还有十多棵没拔。
“不拔起来，要怎么整地呢？”
“傻孩子！不用拔，拔起来干什么呢？”
“可是不是要整地吗？”沈明慧是真的不解，“而且不是说，这些蔬菜长坏了，也不能吃啊！就把它拔掉就好了………”
对方笑了笑，拿起锄头挥下去，将那些蔬菜砸烂，菜叶四处飞散；沈明慧看着，觉得好讶异。
“明慧，就这样做，来，你试试看。”
沈明慧拿起另一把锄头，比丘尼教着她，“挥下去，将这些蔬菜都打烂，然后等一下整土的时候，连着菜叶一起翻动，将这些菜叶埋进土里。”
她照做，尽管心里不解，顿时，十多棵蔬菜都碎，不管是拔起来的，还是没拔起来，这很轻松，至少比刚才试图将蔬菜拔起来更不费力。
可是，她不懂……
比丘尼看着，笑了笑，“傻孩子，有些东西，干嘛急着把它除掉？

沈明慧翻着土，将蔬菜菜叶连同土壤一起翻动，同时她也聆听着比丘尼说的话。
这里的修道人，说话都很有智慧，她很喜欢。
“你看，这些蔬菜虽然都不能吃了，可是它不是完全没有用啊！”比丘尼笑了笑，和蔼的看着沈明慧，“不是有首诗说，‘落花不是无情物，化作春泥更护花’？这些蔬菜虽然不能发挥它的功能，但是却可以帮我们肥沃土壤，其实它的贡献并不比我们吃进肚子里的菜要少喔！”
沈明慧听着，全身一震，是啊！这话说得没错，为什么她从没想过？
“孩子，这就跟人生一样，很多伤心难过、痛彻心扉的事，我们都急着想把它忘掉，想把它从心里拔掉，可是做起来好费力，不是吗？有些痛苦根扎得太深，怎么可能说忘就忘？”
她停止翻土，看着这位有智慧的老前辈，沈明慧的眼眶一红，泪水盈眶。
“要不要干脆就不要拔掉，把这些痛苦的记忆留下来，学会跟它共处，就跟这些蔬菜一样，也许你会发现，原来这些痛苦不是一点用处都没有，至少……让我们学会了成长，就跟这些蔬菜肥沃了土壤一样……”
她的泪水不断掉落，哭出了声音，她痛苦的哭泣着，哭声惹人鼻酸，但同时也点着头，承认比丘尼说得对。
比丘尼笑了，将整地的工作留给沈明慧，一个人离开。
沈明慧就在菜圃里整着地，她甚至跪在泥土上，用手将那些菜叶埋进土里，一边不停的哭泣，就算手弄脏了，也不停下来。“呜呜……”
她承认，要忘掉好难，也许要学会跟它共处比较简单。
也许她真的只能将痛苦打碎，像整土一样彻底翻遍，将每一片痛苦的记忆翻进自己心里、埋进自己心里，在刺痛中学会成长……
这真的好难……
晚上九点，沈明慧回到了小房间。在这里两个多月，她每天晚上都待在这里，安安静静做着自己的事。
晚上是最恐怖的时间，她没有事情可以忙了，可是她又不敢睡——因为她一定会想起那至今仍然让她痛彻心扉的恐怖事实。
她之所以要躲到这里来，就是为了不再去跟外界联系，不想知道外面的状况，想将自己永远彻底的关起来。
可是她忘记了，她还是得面对一个人，那就是她自己！
深夜时，孤独特别难熬，刚到时的每一夜，她只能不断的哭泣，甚至痛苦得自残。
后来这里的比丘尼教她让心情平静下来的方法，也就是抄写佛经，她开始在深夜里拿起笔，抄写着那些经文，抄了一张又一张纸。
每天晚上，她都重复同样的工作，直到疲累已极，趴在桌上睡去，或是直接躺在榻榻米上睡着。

今晚也是如此，她抄写着经文，嘴里边念着。这里的老前辈说，抄写经文可以安定心情，也可以……帮忙超渡亡魂。
content_en:
Now I only eat to maintain my own life, so that I can survive, and also so that I can... do more things for Tinghan.
After the meal, Shen Minghui helped take the dishes to the kitchen and help with cleaning. Living here, she should do whatever she can to help.
After all, she was eating and drinking here for free and not doing anything. Firstly, her conscience was uneasy; secondly, she had to make herself do more things so that she would stop thinking wildly and continue to be sad.
She knew that now she was confused and even desperate about the future - she once didn't know how to go on alone, and where could she go?
He is dead...
She can only face the devouring emptiness, the ruthless cycle of day and night, and no longer knows what else she can do?
"Minghui, let's go!"
Shen Minghui was in a daze in front of the sink while she washed all the dishes. If you have nothing to do well, you can only think about it like this and let your head go down a dead end.
That's why in order to keep herself busy, she must arrange herself to do many things non-stop from waking up in the morning to going to bed at night.
She then picked up the hoe and accompanied a bhikshuni to the small vegetable garden behind the rough house. Today she will help prepare the land and prepare to plant vegetable seedlings, hoping that new vegetables will grow.
This is just one of the things she has to do in her more than two months of life here. In addition, she will also help tidy up the monastery, sweep and mop the floor, and organize the study. It is not until evening that she has time to do her own things.
But she is very afraid of the night. She is afraid that after dark, even late at night, she will still arrange a lot of things for herself, just begging not to come down or calm down...
"Minghui, today is all about planting new vegetables."
"Then what are we going to do?" Of course she wouldn't. She was born in the Shen family and had good food and drink. If she hadn't come here, she wouldn't have known that vegetables were grown.
Now, she is simply dressed in jeans and a T-shirt. She is no longer the same Shen Minghui who played elegant music on the stage.
"Turn the soil over so that the nutrients in the soil can be evenly distributed, and then plant the vegetable seedlings so that you can wait for the harvest."
Shen Minghui nodded. She took off her shoes and walked into the vegetable garden. The soil was icy and soft when she stepped on it. It felt quite fun.
She showed a rare smile and looked at the small vegetable garden. At this time, she suddenly saw several vegetables in the far corner that had not been pulled up during the previous harvest.
Ask people here, it's because the vegetables don't grow well. The leaves are withered and yellow, or they don't grow well. The whole vegetables are thin and small, and you can tell at a glance that they are inedible.
But Shen Minghui didn't understand. If that was the case, why not just pull it up and throw it away? Since those vegetables are inedible, why are they left in the vegetable garden?
Shen Minghui didn't understand, but she thought that since the land needed to be prepared to plant new vegetables now, those vegetables should not be able to stay in the same place.
So Shen Minghui stepped forward and planned to pull up all the vegetables that were not very large, about a dozen incompletely grown vegetables, and put them aside, planning to take them away and throw them away later.
She tried hard to pull it out, but it was actually very hard because the roots of vegetables were hidden deep in the ground and sometimes it was not easy to pull them out.
No wonder when it’s time to harvest, you must bring a sickle and use a mower to cut up all the vegetables.
Shen Minghui smiled. No wonder the famous saying said, "Everyone who sows with tears will reap with joy." When harvesting vegetables, you really have to cut them! I can’t pull it out even with a puller!
She pulled out several trees vigorously, but each one was very laborious, making her sweat profusely and gasping for air.
God! It's really troublesome. If I had known that day, I would have suggested to Master to cut up all these vegetables and throw them away. Now there is no need to expend so much effort...
While complaining, Shen Minghui continued to pick vegetables, but at this moment, someone behind her laughed and exclaimed repeatedly.
"Minghui, we don't need those dishes.pull! "
Looking back, "Why? Don't you need to prepare the land? "
The nun also walked into the vegetable garden, with a kind smile on her face, and walked to Shen Minghui. Several vegetable plants at the site have been pulled up and put aside, and there are still more than ten vegetables on the ground that have not been pulled out.
“How can we prepare the land if we don’t pull it up? "
"Silly boy! There's no need to pull it out. What's the point of pulling it out? "
“But don’t we need to prepare the land? Shen Minghui was really puzzled, "And it doesn't mean that these vegetables can't be eaten even if they grow bad!" Just pull it out..."
The other party smiled, picked up the hoe and swung it down, smashing the vegetables and causing the leaves to fly everywhere. Shen Minghui looked at it, feeling very surprised.
"Minghui, just do this, come on, give it a try. "
Shen Minghui picked up another hoe, and the bhikshuni taught her, "Swing it down and smash all the vegetables. Then when the soil is being plowed, turn over the leaves along with them and bury the leaves into the soil. "
She did as she was told, even though she was confused. Suddenly, more than a dozen vegetables were broken into pieces, whether they were pulled up or not. This was very easy, at least less effortful than trying to pull up the vegetables just now.
But, she doesn't understand...
The bhikshuni looked at it and smiled, "Silly boy, there are some things, why are you so anxious to get rid of them?
Shen Minghui turned over the soil, turning the vegetable leaves together with the soil. At the same time, she also listened to what the bhikshuni said.
The monks here speak very wisely, and she likes them very much.
"Look, although these vegetables are inedible, they are not completely useless!" The bhikshuni smiled and looked at Shen Minghui kindly, "Isn't there a poem that says, 'Falling flowers are not heartless things, they turn into spring mud to protect the flowers'? Although these vegetables cannot perform their functions, they can help us fertilize the soil. In fact, their contribution is no less than the vegetables we eat!"
Shen Minghui listened, and her whole body was shocked, yes! This was true, why had she never thought about it?
"Child, this is just like life. There are many sad and heart-wrenching things. We are eager to forget them and pull them out of our hearts, but it is very difficult to do, isn't it? Some pains are rooted too deeply. How can we just forget them?"
She stopped turning the soil and looked at this wise old man. Shen Minghui's eyes turned red and filled with tears.
"How about you just don't pull it out, keep these painful memories, learn to live with them, just like these vegetables, maybe you will find that these pains are not useless at all, at least... let us learn to grow, just like these vegetables fertilize the soil..."
Her tears kept falling, and she cried out. She cried in pain, and her cry was sour, but at the same time she nodded, admitting that the bhikshuni was right.
The nun smiled, left the land preparation work to Shen Minghui, and left alone.
Shen Minghui was tidying the ground in the vegetable garden. She even knelt on the soil and buried the vegetable leaves into the soil with her hands. She kept crying, even if her hands were dirty, she would not stop. "Woooo..."
She admitted that it was difficult to forget, but perhaps easier to learn to live with it.
Maybe she really can only break the pain into pieces, dig through it like soil, dig every piece of painful memory into her heart, bury it in her heart, and learn to grow through the pain...
This is really difficult...
At nine o'clock in the evening, Shen Minghui returned to the small room. She stayed here every night for more than two months, doing her own thing quietly.
Night was the scariest time. She had nothing to do, but she didn't dare to sleep - because she would definitely think of the horrific fact that still hurt her heart.
The reason why she wanted to hide here was so that she would no longer have contact with the outside world, she didn't want to know the situation outside, and she wanted to lock herself up completely forever.
But she forgot that she still had to face aThat person is herself!
Loneliness was particularly difficult late at night. Every night when she first arrived, she could only cry constantly, and even hurt herself in pain.
Later, the nuns here taught her a way to calm down, which was to copy Buddhist scriptures. She began to pick up a pen late at night and copy those scriptures, one piece after another.
Every night, she repeated the same task until she was so exhausted that she fell asleep on the table or directly on the tatami.
It was the same tonight, she was copying scriptures and chanting them. The old-timers here said that copying scriptures can calm the mood, and can also... help transcend the souls of the dead.
